Observed puzzle pattern: input has a binary-pattern panel (nonzero color such as 3 or 6, zero background), a solid separator column (e.g. 4 or 7), and a same-sized panel that is mostly a background color (e.g. 9 or 3) with sparse zeros. Ignore separator and right background color except distinguishing zero holes. Verify panel alignment: separator is one column; panels are equal width. Solved 16x27 instance had 13-column panels separated by col 13; same intersection rule yielded correct 16x13 output. Avoid simply recoloring the left panel: the sparse zero mask removes pixels at aligned coordinates.
